chemistry.notes: Estimated: page lists the 2025 IONIQ 5 N under the same 84 kWh SK On NCM 811 pouch pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database estimates 80.0 kWh usable for the N, equal to its figure for the 84 kWh Long Range (same pack).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 owner's manual page (code NE1n) describes manual plus navigation-automatic Battery Conditioning; the page does not name the model, NE1N being the IONIQ 5 N platform code (inference).

dc_max_kw.notes: Hyundai Canada N page (2027 model year): charge speed 238 kW on a 350 kW DC fast charger. Conflicts: Wikipedia spec table also 238 kW; EV Database 263 kW (Hyundai Europe claims 260 kW for the Long Range); an image-based Hyundai Europe N sheet appeared to say 239 kW but could not be reliably read and is not cited.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 IONIQ 5 page gives 10.9 kW home charging for the 84 kWh car; the N uses the same 84 kWh E-GMP pack and the same family of onboard charger (EV Database lists 11 kW for both the N and the 84 kWh Long Range). Hyundai Canada's N page states no AC figure. A search summary of Hyundai USA's N compare-specs page mentions 10.9 kW Level 2, but the page text could not be read, so it is not cited. An Australian listing gives 10.5 kW for its market.
